mapper.select: SELECT T.VALUEID, T.VLDATE, T.PRODCODE, T.PROD4SHORT, T.PROFITTYPE, T.PRODNETASSET, T.PRODTOTQTY, T.UNPAYPROFIT, T.YIELD, T.TOTYIELD, T.NETVALUE, T.TOTNETVALUE, T.CURYIELD, T.TOTCURYIELD, T.YIELD7, INFO.CCY FROM PRD_VALUATION T JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON T.PRODCODE = INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID
SELECT INFO.VDATE, INFO.MDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT INFO WHERE INFO.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{prodcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PRODCODE, INFO.FINPROD_ABBR PRODNAME, INFO.PROFIT_TYPE PROFITTYPE, DEALEX.PORTFOLIO_ID PTLID, INFO.VDATE, FCCR.BASIS, CAP.ACCT_NO ACCTNO, SUM(DECODE(DEAL.PS, 'C1', 1, 'C2', 1, 'C10', 1, -1) * NVL(DEAL.TRADE_AMT, 0)) PRINAMT, SUM(DECODE(DEAL.PS, 'C1', 1, 'C2', 1, 'C10', 1, -1) * NVL(DEAL.SHARE_AMT, 0)) PRINQTY FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD DEALEX ON DEAL.TRADE_ID = DEALEX.TRADE_ID JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO CAP ON DEALEX.PORTFOLIO_ID = CAP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND CAP.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01' JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO CASH ON INFO.FINPROD_ID = CASH.FINPROD_ID JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR ON CASH.CASH_ID = FCCR.CASH_ID AND CASH.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' AND CASH.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND DEAL.PS IN ('C1', 'C2', 'C10', 'C4', 'C17', 'C18','C16', 'C5')
AND INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN
#{item, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND DEAL.SETTLE_DATE <= #{vldate, jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, INFO.FINPROD_ABBR, INFO.PROFIT_TYPE, DEALEX.PORTFOLIO_ID, CAP.ACCT_NO, INFO.VDATE, FCCR.BASIS

SELECT PRD.PRODCODE ACCOUNTID, PRD.PTLID, DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 ASSETTYPE, TYPE6.TYPE_6 FIRSTTYPE, INFO.FINPROD_ID FINPRODID, INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ASSETCODE, INFO.FINPROD_NAME ASSETNAME, DEAL.INV_AIM TARGET, INFO.MDATE, INFO.CCY, DEAL.CHL_ID CHANNEL, DECODE(DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2, 'F01', DEAL.YIELD, RULER.YIELD) YIELD, RULER.BASIS, DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID BONDACCT, INFO.PROFIT_TYPE PROFITTYPE, SUM(DECODE(DEAL.PS, 'T01', 1, 'T05', 1, -1) * NVL(DEAL.TRADE_AMT, 0)) PRINAMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD EX ON DEAL.TRADE_ID = EX.TRADE_ID JOIN (SELECT FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FINPROD_NAME, FINPROD_TYPE2, MDATE, CCY, PROFIT_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE2, MDATE, CCY, PROFIT_TYPE FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT) INFO ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID AND DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = INFO.FINPROD_TYPE2 JOIN (SELECT FP.FINPROD_ID PRODUUID, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PRODCODE, FP.FINPROD_NAME PRODNAME, FPA.PORTFOLIO_ID PTLID FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID WHERE FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16') PRD ON EX.PORTFOLIO_ID = PRD.PTLID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE TYPE6 ON INFO.FINPROD_ID = TYPE6.FINPROD_ID JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO CASH ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = CASH.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE RULER ON CASH.CASH_ID = RULER.CASH_ID WHERE DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 != 'F16' AND CASH.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' AND DEAL.SETTLE_DATE <= #{vldate, jdbcType=DATE} AND PRD.PRODCODE = #{prodInfo.prodcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DEAL.PS IN ('T01', 'T02', 'T03', 'T05', 'T19', 'T08') AND DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' GROUP BY PRD.PRODCODE, INFO.FINPROD_ID, PRD.PTLID, DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2, TYPE6.TYPE_6, INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, INFO.FINPROD_NAME, DEAL.INV_AIM, INFO.MDATE, INFO.CCY, DEAL.CHL_ID, DECODE(DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2, 'F01', DEAL.YIELD, RULER.YIELD), RULER.BASIS, DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, INFO.PROFIT_TYPE

SELECT CASH.CASH_ID CASHID, /*现金流代码*/ INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PRODCODE, /*产品代码*/ CASH.FEE_ID FEEID, /*费用代码*/ FEE.APPLY_TYPE APPLYTYPE, /*关联范围，产品、通道、其他*/ FEE.FEE_NAME FEENAME, /*费用名称*/ FEE.FEE_TYPE FEETYPE, /*费用类型*/ FEE.BASIC_BILL BASICBILL, /*计费基数，存续本金、资产规模*/ FEE.BASIS, /*计算基础，A/360，A/365*/ FEE.CHARGE_TYPE CHARGETYPE, /*收费类型，计提费用，不规则费用*/ CALC.YIELD /*费率*/ FROM FIN_CASH_INFO CASH JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE CALC ON CASH.CASH_ID = CALC.CASH_ID JOIN MST_FEEINFO FEE ON CASH.FEE_ID = FEE.FEE_ID AND FEE.CHARGE_TYPE = '01' JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON CASH.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID AND CASH.CASH_TYPE_1 = '03'
AND INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{prodInfo.prodcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT PST.FEE_TYPE FEETYPE, INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PRODCODE, SUM(NVL(PST.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP, 0)) UNPAIDFEE FROM BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE PST JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON PST.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID AND INFO.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' WHERE INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{prodcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PST.FEE_TYPE = #{feetype, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PST.CDATE = (SELECT MAX(PST2.CDATE) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE PST2 WHERE PST2.FINPROD_ID = PST.FINPROD_ID AND PST2.FEE_TYPE = PST.FEE_TYPE AND PST2.CDATE <= #{cdate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY PST.FEE_TYPE, INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID

SELECT NVL(T.VALUATION, 0) FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION T WHERE T.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.VAL_DATE = (SELECT MAX(T.VAL_DATE) FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION F WHERE F.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND F.VAL_DATE <= #{cdate, jdbcType=DATE})

SELECT NVL(SUM(DECODE(PBP.BONU_SCALC_FLAG, '01', NVL(PBP.UNIT_BONUS_VLU, 0), NVL(PBP.TOTAL_AMT, 0) / POSI.TDY_SHARE_AMT)), 0) UNITBONUS FROM PRD_BONUS_PLAN_N PBP JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD POSI ON PBP.FINPROD_ID = POSI.FINPROD_ID WHERE PBP.BASE_DATE - 1 days = POSI.CDATE AND PBP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PBP.BASE_DATE <= #{edate, jdbcType=DATE}
AND PBP.BASE_DATE >= #{sdate, jdbcType=DATE}
